svg.aria-label: Ayesha's messy desktop. A code editor with a dev server open. Goodreads open on her read shelf, five stars each: As Long As the Lemon Trees Grow by Zoulfa Katouh, war fiction set in Syria, Mornings in Jenin by Susan Abulhawa, historical fiction about Palestine from before the Nakba to the 2000s, and Poisoner in Chief by Stephen Kinzer, nonfiction about the CIA. A recipe for lebu-cha: 1 cup water, 1 and a half spoons sugar or honey, 1 cardamom, a pinch of cinnamon, a handful of mint, some squeezed lime. A machine learning notebook with a loss curve. A log of nuclear accidents: Chernobyl, Fukushima, Kyshtym, Three Mile Island, Windscale, Goiania, Tokaimura. A to-do list of questionable decisions. A row of browser tabs. Every so often she minimizes everything into the dock, leaving a clean desktop, then opens it all again.

g.text: As Long As the Lemon Trees Grow
by Zoulfa Katouh · war fiction, Syria
